C-15.IntentSummary: Two tracks: (W) Windows-first distribution — icon set, titlebar/menu platform pass, cfg audit, CI build lane with NSIS + multi-platform updater feed; (M) Mac App Store — tauri/app-store wiring, sandbox entitlements, ad-hoc sandbox dry-run, security-scoped bookmarks, in-process search, renderer build-mode gating, App Store Connect submission prep.

P-000.Title: Phase 0 — icon master + full icon set (shared)

T-001.Title: Produce a 1024×1024 master and regenerate src-tauri/icons

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Upscale static/icon.png (256) to 1024 via Lanczos + light unsharp (no vector source exists — bundled .icns is also 256-only); run `npx tauri icon`; commit icon.ico/icon.icns/full png set; tauri.conf.json bundle.icon lists ico+icns+png; macOS DMG unchanged visually.

m009_menu.rs non-macOS branches complete (no dead menus on Windows); renderer titleBar component renders a standard Windows titlebar layout (existing titlebar-nav--osx class gains a windows variant); accelerators display Ctrl (not Cmd); tab strip + drag region verified under decorations:true.

m045_ext/live_endpoint unix-socket path gains a TCP loopback fallback on windows (or feature-gated disable with clear status); signal-hook/zombie-reaper guarded (main.rs:753 already cfg(unix)); mt_paths windows branch reviewed against real SHOME paths; cargo check passes for x86_64-pc-windows-msvc target.

Verification.Command: rustup target add x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && cargo check --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml

T-W3.Title: CI: windows-latest build lane + multi-platform updater feed

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: release.yml matrix gains windows-latest/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc building NSIS (.exe) with updater artifacts, build-only (no publish) until smoke-proven; publish job merges per-platform platforms{} fragments into latest.json (darwin-aarch64 + windows-x86_64); smoke-launch/windows-specific steps skipped or conditionally run.

P-M.Title: Phase M — Mac App Store track

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Cargo app-store = ["tauri/app-store"]; Entitlements.plist: app-sandbox + files.user-selected.read-write + network.client + network.server (axum live viewer listens on loopback); mas.conf.json overlay selects capabilities ["mas"] (mas.json already exists) and entitlements; local build --no-default-features --features app-store succeeds.

T-M2.Title: Sandbox dry-run: ad-hoc signed + entitlements, log breakages

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: codesign ad-hoc with Entitlements.plist; app launches via CUA; documented pass/fail per surface: open-file via dialog, recent-files persistence after restart, folder watch, live viewer, spell, themes; failures feed T-M3/T-M4.

T-M3.Title: Security-scoped bookmarks for recent files + watched folders

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: New module wraps bookmark create/resolve (raw NSData from sandbox-ext; no extra deps beyond core-foundation already in tree via cocoa); recent docs and watcher roots persist across relaunch inside sandbox; unit tests with round-trip in tmp dirs; non-MAS build unaffected.

T-M4.Title: In-process project search for MAS (replace ripgrep spawn)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: app-store branch of search spawns no binaries: ignore-walk + regex crate reuse; result shape identical to ripgrep path (same IPC contract); non-MAS builds keep ripgrep; unit tests cover a fixture tree.

mt_build_mode command (mas|normal); settings/menu hides Export PDF/DOCX (pandoc), Screenshot, "Make default .md handler", project-wide search entry when mas; no dead buttons showing raw backend errors.

T-M6.Title: App Store Connect prep + submission pipeline

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Checklist doc: bundle id com.xronocode.mark registered for macOS, Apple Distribution cert + Mac Installer cert in keychain, productbuild .pkg script (tools/release/mas-pkg.sh), ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption=false, privacy answers aligned with site privacy page, support URL (site /guide/), screenshots from showcase set; TestFlight upload validated.

Verification.Command: xcrun altool/Transporter validate + TestFlight build appears
